title: Baldur's Gate 3

quotes.text: Why do beautiful people taste better? It hardly seems fair on the ugly — they have such wonderful personalities.
Tongs. A wide variety of tongs.
Halsin wasn't originally a romance option — Larian added him after fans latched onto the character during early access.
The finished game holds over 236 hours of recorded dialogue across a script that runs past two million words.
Larian spent six years building the game, three of them in public early access.
Every lawful-good cleric run ends with someone shoved off a cliff for the extra experience.
Every player accidentally murders a shopkeeper once, then reloads the save in shame.
Long rest gets called after every single fight, whether anyone actually needs it or not.

notes: appid 1086940 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, developer/publisher Larian Studios), distinguished from the Digital Deluxe Edition DLC (2378500) and Toolkit Data (2956320) in storesearch results. The Astarion quote is corroborated verbatim in a ScreenRant quote roundup. The narrator 'Tongs' line is cross-verified against narrator voice actor Amelia Tyler's own interview quote of the same line (PC Gamer/Yahoo coverage of her interview), which is about as close to a primary source as is reachable without game files; TVTropes and the BG3 wiki both blocked WebFetch with 403s. Dev trivia (Halsin's romance route being added post-reveal due to fan reaction, the six-year/three-years-in-EA development timeline, and the 236-hour dialogue total from a 2M+ word script) is drawn from Larian's own public statements as reported by TheGamer, ScreenRant, and a widely reported fan tally covered by PC Gamer and GamesRadar.
